description: This file defines a custom guardrail implementation for HiddenLayer's safety checks within a larger AI/ML context. It includes functions for authentication, a class wrapping HiddenLayer's API calls, and methods for applying guardrails to request/response data, handling JWT tokens, and communicating with the HiddenLayer API.

classes.name: HiddenlayerGuardrail
classes.description: A custom guardrail class that interfaces with HiddenLayer API for safety checks, handling authentication, request processing, and enforcing guard policies.
